coverage: Trondheim, Trondelag and the Helgeland coast through Bodo. Mainland Norway and coastal islands only; excludes Svalbard and Jan Mayen. Adjacent editions overlap by 0.5 degrees latitude (approximately 56 km).
label: Central Norway

landValidationNotes.bronnoysund: The town-centre probe is on source land but falls outside its quantized coast at zooms 4 and 5. Use an inland town point for overview checks; retain the Explore coordinate.
